steps.expression: (() => { const ta = document.querySelectorAll('textarea'); const phs = Array.from(ta).map(t => t.placeholder); return { placeholders: phs }; })()
steps.description: 获取所有 textarea placeholder

steps.expression: (() => { const ta = document.querySelectorAll('textarea'); for (const t of ta) { if (t.placeholder.includes('策略说明')) return { found: true }; } return { found: false }; })()
steps.description: 验证 placeholder-策略说明

steps.expression: (() => { const ta = document.querySelectorAll('textarea'); for (const t of ta) { if (t.placeholder.includes('适配场景')) return { found: true }; } return { found: false }; })()
steps.description: 验证 placeholder-适配场景

steps.expression: (() => { const btns = document.querySelectorAll('button'); const texts = Array.from(btns).filter(b => b.offsetHeight > 0).map(b => b.textContent.replace(/\s/g, '')); return { visibleButtons: texts }; })()
